description: DeepSeek content source registry. Discovered via robots.txt/sitemap/llms.txt probing.

api-docs.deepseek.com.notes: API docs, Docusaurus SSR. No llms.txt and no .md variants (unknown paths fall through to the SPA shell with HTTP 200) -- pages are mirrored by converting the server-rendered HTML article body to markdown. Sitemap per locale: /sitemap.xml (en), /zh-cn/sitemap.xml (zh-cn), 63 pages each.

www.deepseek.com.notes: Product landing; not part of this mirror
